content: Greenhouse climate-control products (Priva, Fancom, GrowDirector, ControlByWeb) integrate heaters/fans/humidifiers/vents under one automated controller with sensor+logic loops, tiered from simple entry-level on/off controls to full commercial automation. Ventilation is treated as essential for CO2/moisture exchange, not optional. Products differentiate on automation sophistication (rule-based to predictive) and integration breadth (irrigation, lighting, climate combined) rather than on having climate control at all -- that is baseline.
